name: briefing
description: Today's Brief. Daily flow plugin, and — as of 2026-09-15 — the home for every periodic 'what's going on' surface in Nucleus. Owns /brief (today's interactive working surface as a Cowork artifact), /process-brief (routes annotations + task/outreach actions to drafts, CRM, and person/bizdev nodes), /brief --tomorrow (calendar-first planning of the next business day; /plan-tomorrow remains a direct alias), /review (synthesized weekly digest, moved from cortex), /timeline (chronological activity view, moved from cortex), and /dashboard (rich visual Cowork-artifact stack surface, moved from ops; ops retains /status and /diagnose). v0.5.0 (End-Day Routine Improvement Spec): 5 fixed sections — Center of Gravity, Calendar Block (visual timeline + written list with notes), Priority Tasks (richer per-row actions: done/delegate/skip/not_important/annotate), Outreach Queue (per-contact actions + optional bucket/value-add/signal tags), Yesterday's Reflection. Everything is filtered against memory/surfacing-prefs.md before render (suppression + repeat-ignore learning). One localStorage blob brief-YYYY-MM-DD (schema_version 0.7.0: tasks/annotations/outreach_actions/reflection, +reprioritize) mined nightly by cortex /listen Step 1.5, reviewed at /morning; /end-day Step 2c still mines it synchronously when the user runs it, since /end-day is optional. v0.6.0: sandbox-safe inline controls (no native dialogs), on-the-fly reprioritize, and a state-mirror file so downstream commands can read brief state. v0.6.1: state mirror actually works — /brief resolves + verifies a filesystem MCP tool and declares it in the artifact's mcp_tools allowlist (the Cowork sandbox rejects undeclared or non-fully-qualified tools); persistent manual-sync banner + paste path when no tool is connected. v0.6.6: /brief --tomorrow is the documented next-day-planning entry point. v0.7.0 (2026-09-17): full round-trip coverage so nothing depends on /end-day — a hosted claude.ai artifact-capabilities discovery path (for the browser-tab case desktop's filesystem-MCP mirror can't reach) plus a shared preflight read-back in /brief, /process-brief, /end-day, and /listen; outreach rows gain an annotation textarea and a Skip duration mini-form (return_on, weekday-adjusted for 1d/3d); calendar events gain a per-meeting note textarea; the reflection card splits into read-only Yesterday's + editable Today's (autosaves, chips from today's done tasks); the Sync button is renamed 'Sync brief state'; /brief now reads yesterday's closures.json and the new cross-plugin snooze ledger (briefs/.snooze-ledger.json) before every render so closed items disappear and skipped items return on schedule even without /end-day. Configurable via /setup-brief and /setup-plan.
